comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Florida-focused residential catastrophe property insurer selling to homeowners and condo associations, not specialty casualty or professional liability.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Risk-bearing specialty commercial P&C carrier with E&S and specialty casualty, sold through brokers, like Bowhead.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: E&S specialty commercial carrier selling through wholesale brokers, with general liability and property lines, closely similar to Bowhead.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Insurance broker earning commissions and fees without underwriting risk, unlike a risk-bearing carrier.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Franchised personal lines insurance agency earning commissions and royalties, not a commercial specialty carrier.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Regional personal lines carrier (homeowners, auto) selling to individuals, not commercial specialty liability.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Commercial specialty P&C carrier with general liability and casualty written through brokers, though title insurance adds a segment.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Life insurance, title/escrow and mortgage origination conglomerate; unrelated to specialty P&C underwriting.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Insurance distributor earning commissions and fees; does not bear underwriting risk like Bowhead's carrier.
